item.title: Bonyuu Club ~Otona no Milk Time~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Tryset Light
  • 発売日: 2009-12-25
  • スコア: 6.55/10 (13 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 母乳倶楽部～大人のミルクタイム～
  • 英語名: Bonyuu Club Otona no Milk Time

あらすじ

Hitoshi is just a white-collar worker. One day, he finds a strange shop sign when he is on his way home. The sign says “Preschool for Adults”. “Preschool for adults? What is it…?” Whe he looks at the sign, a girl talks to him. She works at the preschool and misunderstands that he is a new student. She forcibly takes him to the room and they go inside…. Yes, some adults in preschool uniform play with teachers…. It is actually a preschool for tired white-collar workers….

item.description:

  • 発売日: 2009-09-25
  • スコア: 5.8100000000000005/10 (23 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 妻交感～他人に抱かれる妻を想像して～
  • 英語名: Tsuma Koukan Tanin ni Dakareru Tsuma o Souzou Shite

あらすじ

Nobuyuki is a white-collor worker. He got married to Sanae three years ago. She is quiet, but a good wife. They seem to have a happy life…. But there is one thing Nobuyuki concerns. Sanae persistently asks for sex recently. One day, he talks Yuuji, his co-worker, about it. On the next weekend, Nobuyuki and Sanae are invited to Yuuji’s house and enjoy having dinner together. A while later, Nobuyuki gets drunk and falls asleep…. Just when he wakes up, he finds Erena, Yuuji’s wife, giving him a blowjob. According to Erena, Yuuji and Sanae are having sex in a different room….
